content.comment_body: Hello, I'm a beginner with [product_name], so please excuse this possibly simple question. I am unable to see the live countdown on my [product_name] display and through the Webserver. On the PC, the message text screen displays the decreasing value properly, and I've configured the message text destination for both the Webserver and [product_name] display. Any assistance would be greatly appreciated. Kind regards, [user_name]
It’s difficult to determine the issue remotely. Could you upload your [product_name] configuration and [product_name] Web Editor project as a ZIP file?

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that the [product_name] display and Webserver do not show live countdown values, whereas the PC interface does. This creates confusion, especially for those new to the system, as real-time feedback is expected directly on the device or Webserver but not visible there.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect real-time countdown values to be visible on both the [product_name] display and the Webserver interface, not limited to the PC programming screen.
